cordana.symptoms: Large oval or zig-zag yellow to orange bordered brown necrotic lesions, often advancing along leaf veins.

organic_measures.name: De-leafing & Botanical Spray
organic_measures.method: Prune severely spotted leaves. Spray neem oil formulation (5 ml/L) with soap emulsifier.

chemical_measures.name: Mancozeb 75% WP or Propiconazole 25% EC
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Wear PPE. Apply with mineral oil adjuvant if recommended locally.

prevention_measures: Improve field drainage and eliminate standing water.
Maintain appropriate mat spacing to lower canopy humidity.
Remove infected leaf trash from the plantation floor.
sources: ICAR - National Research Centre for Banana (NRCB) Disease Guide

pestalotiopsis.symptoms: Circular to dark brown irregular spots with gray necrotic centers studded with minute black pycnidia.

organic_measures.name: Trichoderma viride Spray
organic_measures.method: Apply bio-fungicide Trichoderma viride (5 g/L) to foliage.

chemical_measures.name: Carbendazim 50% WP
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Use strictly according to safety label guidelines.

prevention_measures: Avoid mechanical injury to banana leaves during cultivation.
Ensure optimal potassium and micronutrient soil nutrition.

sigatoka.symptoms: Small yellowish-green streaks expanding into dark brown/black necrotic spots with yellow halos, causing premature leaf collapse.

organic_measures.name: Sanitary Pruning & Mineral Oil Spray
organic_measures.method: Systematically cut and bury/burn affected leaf tips. Spray horticultural mineral oil emulsion (10 ml/L).
organic_measures.frequency: Every 10 to 14 days during wet season

chemical_measures.name: Propiconazole 25% EC or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Rotate systemic triazoles with protectant fungicides (Mancozeb) to prevent fungicide resistance.

banana_healthy.symptoms: Broad, intact, deep green leaf canopy without necrotic spots, tears, or marginal yellowing.

organic_measures.name: Organic Compost & Mulching
organic_measures.method: Apply 10 kg farmyard manure (FYM) per mat along with bio-fertilizers (Azospirillum & PSB).

prevention_measures: Desucker regularly to maintain 1 mother + 1 sucker mat density.
